## Research and projects

::: {.timeline}
::: {.timeline-item}
[2026]{.timeline-year}

**GUARDRAIL: reliable knowledge graphs**  
Tracking uncertainty and source evidence in knowledge graphs for more reliable fact-checking. Franco-German AI for Science proposal.
:::

::: {.timeline-item}
[2026]{.timeline-year}

**NEXUS: scientific document retrieval**  
Using domain ontologies to improve document ranking and explain search results. Franco-German AI for Science proposal.
:::

::: {.timeline-item}
[2026]{.timeline-year}

**XPO: prompt optimization**  
Leading a 12-month Software Campus project with Celonis on improving prompts using explainability methods.
:::

::: {.timeline-item}
[2025 to present]{.timeline-year}

**GenKI4Media: generative AI for journalism**  
Detecting unsupported claims in generated text and controlling summary length with diffusion language models. BMFTR project with dpa and Deutsche Welle.
:::

::: {.timeline-item}
[2024 to 2025]{.timeline-year}

**Explaining embedding similarity for retrieval**  
Using ALTI and Integrated Gradients to explain embedding similarity and improve document ranking.
:::

::: {.timeline-item}
[2024]{.timeline-year}

**Green-AI Hub: product carbon footprints**  
Matching product components with environmental data using LLMs. Published at NLP4Ecology 2025.
:::

::: {.timeline-item}
[2023 to 2024]{.timeline-year}

**Data4Transparency: investigative journalism**  
Extracting entities and relationships from large document collections in collaboration with OCCRP.
:::

::: {.timeline-item}
[Since 2023]{.timeline-year}

**PhD: alternative uses for explanations**  
Thesis topic *Beyond Human Interaction: Alternative Applications for Explanations*. Studying how model explanations can help detect data shifts, improve retrieval, and check factual accuracy.
:::

::: {.timeline-item}
[2020 to 2022]{.timeline-year}

**PLASS: supply-chain risk monitoring**  
Extracting risks from multilingual news and detecting data shifts through model explanations. BMWi project with Siemens.
:::

::: {.timeline-item}
[2019 to 2020]{.timeline-year}

**Neural network explanations**  
Master's research at DFKI on Pattern-Guided Attribution and Pattern-Guided Integrated Gradients.
:::
:::
